parse.wikitext:
==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Fremennik" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Kill each of the [[Dagannoth Kings]].
''Note: Completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.''
|
*Way of getting past the two-player doors at the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon|dungeon]] entrance (help from another player, [[pet rock]] and [[rune thrownaxe]]s, or {{SCP|Agility|85|link=y}} {{Boostable|y}} for the [[Rocks (Waterbirth Island)|rock shortcut]])
*See the [[Dagannoth_Kings/Strategies|strategy guide]]
|-
|2. Craft 56 [[astral rune]]s simultaneously from Essence without the use of [[Runic extract|Extracts]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]]
*{{SCP|Runecraft|82|link=y}}{{boostable|y}}
*28 [[Pure essence|pure]] or [[daeyalt essence]] (this task is not bypass-able with [[Raiments of the Eye]])
|-
|3. Create a [[dragonstone amulet]] in the [[Clay forge|Neitiznot furnace]].
''Note: Crafting a [[dragonstone amulet (u)]] is sufficient, you don't need a [[ball of wool]] for this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[The Fremennik Isles]]
*{{SCP|Crafting|80|link=y}}{{boostable|y}}
*[[Dragonstone]], [[gold bar]], and an [[amulet mould]]
|-
|4. Complete a lap of the [[Rellekka Rooftop Course|Rellekka agility course]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|80|link=y}} {{boostable|y}}
|-
|5. Kill the generals of [[Kree'arra|Armadyl]], [[General Graardor|Bandos]], [[Commander Zilyana|Saradomin]] and [[K'ril Tsutsaroth|Zamorak]] in the [[God Wars Dungeon]].
''Note: Having started the [[The Frozen Door]] miniquest is recommended to simultaneously unlock the [[Frozen key (The Frozen Door)|key to Nex]]. You do not have to kill the generals' bodyguards for this task. Unlike most tasks that involve multiple steps, your progress towards this task will not reset when doing other tasks.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of the [[Troll Stronghold]], or completion of the {{SCP|combatachievement}} [[Combat Achievements/Easy|Easy Combat Achievements]] for [[Ghommal's hilt 1]]
*{{SCP|Agility|70|link=y}}, {{SCP|Strength|70|link=y}}, {{SCP|Hitpoints|70|link=y}}, and {{SCP|Ranged|70|link=y}} (only Hitpoints is [[boostable]])
*See the [[God_Wars_Dungeon#Generals|boss overview]] (or see the individual strategy guides for [[Kree'arra/Strategies|Kree'arra]], [[General Graardor/Strategies|General Graardor]], [[Commander Zilyana/Strategies|Commander Zilyana]], and [[K'ril Tsutsaroth/Strategies|K'ril Tsutsaroth]])
|-
|6. Slay a [[Spiritual mage]] within the [[God Wars Dungeon|Godwars Dungeon]]{{sic}}.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of the [[Troll Stronghold]]
*{{SCP|Slayer|83|link=y}}{{boostable|y}}
*[[Weaponry]]
|}
===Rewards===
*[[Fremennik sea boots 4]]:
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Rellekka]] marketplace
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*[[Dagannoth bones]] from the [[Dagannoth Kings]] are now [[noted]], unless this feature is disabled by talking to [[Thorodin]] south of [[Rellekka]]
*15% increased chance of gaining approval in [[Managing Miscellania]] when fishing or woodcutting (other activities always give approval)<ref name="miscapprove"/>
*[[Enchanted lyre]] and its [[Enchanted lyre(i)|imbued variant]] can now be played to teleport to [[Waterbirth Island]], [[Jatizso]], and [[Neitiznot]], aside from [[Rellekka]]
*The [[seal of passage]] is no longer needed to interact with anyone on [[Lunar Isle]], which means you'll no longer be kicked off the island to [[Rellekka]] for doing so (you'll instead gain access to the [[Return Orb]] as a new way of reaching Rellekka)
*[[Fossegrimen]] will [[enchanted lyre(i)|imbue your lyre]] with infinite charges for 200 of each required fish, down from 400
